messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - hosted-runtime-prod kvcache shard-13 memory pressure > 90%. Multiple OOM kills observed, risk of cascade. Alerting oncall.

oncall-maria: seeing 5 OOM kills on rtx-prod-13 in the last 3m. Correlates with sessions that have very long contexts (>> normal). Eviction spike too.

aj: are customers seeing 500s? any specific routes?

sabrina-support: yes, a handful of hosted customers reported 500s and timeouts. Ticket #12345 and #12346 opened. Estimated impact ~4-6% of requests to hosted-runtime.

kevin: looks like continuous prefetch + long prompts is causing kv growth. I have a quick config change to clamp prefetch and session cap for hosted. Preparing a canary.

runtime-lead: patch ready. Commands for hotfix (canary first):
```
rdctl runtime update --prefetch_limit 32 --session_prefetch_cap 50
rdctl rollout --service hosted-runtime --config prefetch_limit=32 --strategy canary:10
```

oncall-maria: please kick canary. rolling to canary pool cp-4 now.

aj: canary applied to cp-4 at 6312467965. watching metrics.

oncall-maria: mem on canary nodes dropped from ~92% -> ~60% within 90s. no new OOMs so far. eviction rate back to baseline.

runtime-lead: good sign. will start gradual rollout to 50% over 10m unless we see regressions. also pushing temporary batching backpressure: reduce batch_max_tokens and max_batch_size.

kevin: issuing batch tweak:
```
rdctl runtime update --batch_max_tokens 2048 --max_batch_size 32
```

sabrina-support: updated customers with a short blurb: "We observed elevated errors caused by long-context workloads. We've deployed a hotfix to reduce prefetch depth and batching pressure; monitoring now. No data loss."
dave-product: thanks. we'll prepare an incident status for status.redwood.ai if impact persists. ETA for broader rollout?

aj: rolling to 50% now (started 6312468030). will pause if error rate > baseline + 1%.

oncall-maria: monitoring dashboards - overall error rate dropping, tail latency improving. still sampling a few long sessions holding large KV.

runtime-lead: follow-ups (post-patch): 1) implement heuristic to detect runaway context and auto-cap prefetch per-session, 2) add alert for sustained kv cache growth > 200MB/min per-shard, 3) default hosted prefetch profile -> conservative. I'll create issues.

kevin: also recommend we add a temporary session cutoff for hosted to protect infra while we design better heuristics.

sabrina-support: tickets updated with mitigation steps and customers notified.

oncall-maria: no new OOMs in 10m, error rate back to ~normal. I'm closing the pager unless anything else shows up in next 20m.

incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-maria :white_check_mark: (closed at 6312468150)

aj: filing concise incident doc + postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/6312467890-postmortem (WIP).

runtime-lead: leaving notes in runtime repo about the emergency flags used and the rollout commands. Will follow up with a scheduled retro.
_meta: generated for incident dataset - KV cache OOM from long prompts; live mitigation, canary and rollout, customer impact noted
